title: Stack
text: 将输入存储到 LIFO 寄存器，输入 4 路、输出 4 路、无直接馈通；按 {Pop empty stack} 指定Pop 空栈；{Stack depth} 指定栈可容纳的条目数、{Trigger type} 指定触发类型 Rising、{Push full stack} 指定 Push 满栈 Dynamic、{Show empty stack indicator port (Empty)} 启用空栈指示端口、{Show full stack indicator port (Full)} 启用满栈指示端口、{Show number of stack entries port (Num)} 启用栈条目数端口、{Show reset port (Rst) to clear internal stack buffer} 启用复位端口、{Clear output port on reset} 指定复位时清除输出端口，按实例取值。

ports.name: Push
ports.summary: 用于推入输入的触发事件 scalar

ports.name: Pop
ports.summary: 用于弹出元素的触发事件 scalar

params.name: Stack depth
params.values: 栈可容纳的条目数 8 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: 触发类型 Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Push full stack
params.values: Push 满栈 Dynamic reallocation (default) | Ignore | Warning | Error

params.name: Pop empty stack
params.values: Pop 空栈 Warning (default) | Ignore | Error

params.name: Show empty stack indicator port (Empty)
params.values: 启用空栈指示端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Show full stack indicator port (Full)
params.values: 启用满栈指示端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Show number of stack entries port (Num)
params.values: 启用栈条目数端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Show reset port (Rst) to clear internal stack buffer
params.values: 启用复位端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Clear output port on reset
params.values: 复位时清除输出端口 off (default) | on
